_readme: Patient journey stages in order. 'status': 'ready' = lessons available, 'planned' = on the roadmap. Add lessons in src/content/lessons/<stage-id>.json and register them in src/content/index.js.

stages.title: Referral
stages.summary: A GP, specialist or other hospital sends the patient. The referral starts the case and decides how clean the data will be later.

stages.title: Scheduling & pre-admission
stages.summary: Appointments, waiting lists, OR and bed planning. Data collected here is the cheapest place to prevent billing errors.

stages.title: Cost approval & insurance check
stages.summary: Check coverage (KVG, UVG, IVG, VVG), request cost approval from insurer or canton, document the answer.

stages.title: Admission & registration
stages.summary: Patient master data, case creation, first movement. Errors here cause most invoice rejections later.

stages.title: Treatment & documentation
stages.summary: Orders, results, nursing and medical documentation in the clinical system, transfers between wards.

stages.title: Service capture & coding
stages.summary: Services, diagnoses (ICD-10-GM) and procedures (CHOP); SwissDRG grouping; TARDOC and outpatient flat rates.

stages.title: Discharge
stages.summary: Discharge letter, follow-up care, data back to the referring doctor.

stages.title: Billing
stages.summary: Invoice creation and tariff validation, XML invoices to insurers, rejections.

stages.title: Accounts receivable & dunning
stages.summary: Payments, reminders, write-offs, integration with SAP FI/CO.

stages.title: Analytics & controlling
stages.summary: Reporting, data quality, revenue completeness, KPIs along order-to-cash.

stages.title: Invoice rejections
stages.summary: Cross-cutting: every rejection has a root cause upstream. Target: no more than 3% of invoices rejected.
